{{Infobox deity}}{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[Category:Has wikidata]][[d:Q10904413]] Wikidata name: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 10:11, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{afc comment|1=Apparently different from {{ill|Twelve Heavenly Generals|en|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Twelve Heavenly Generals|qq=}} Here's your translation with proper use of the "{{ill|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/qq=|qq=}}" template: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 18:09, 3 March 2025 (UTC)|qq=draft|qq=}} {{Unreferenced|date=August 2018|qq=}} '''Jūni Tenshō''' (十二天将, lit. Twelve Heavenly Generals) refers to a symbolic system used within the [[:en:Daliuren|Rokujin Shinka]] divination method, which was essential for [[:en:Onmyōji|Onmyōji]] practitioners such as {{ill|Abe no Seimei|en|安倍晴明|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Abe no Seimei|qq=}}. Originating from constellations centered around the {{ill|Polaris|en|北極星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Polaris|qq=}}, each corresponds to principles of {{ill|Yin-Yang and the Five Elements|en|陰陽五行思想|1=Yin-Yang and Wuxing Theory|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yin-Yang and the Five Elements|qq=}}. Although frequently called [[:en:Twelve Heavenly Generals|Jūni Shinshō]], Jūni Tenshō differs significantly from the Buddhist [[:en:Twelve Devas|Twelve Devas]] and {{ill|Twelve Heavenly Generals|en|十二神将|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Twelve Heavenly Generals|qq=}}. In traditional texts like "Rokujin Yaku," the term "Kami" (神) refers specifically to the twelve Earthly Branches (十二支) placed on the heavenly board (天盤), and "Shō" (将) denotes the Twelve Heavenly Generals themselves. Therefore, "Kami-Shō" (神将) refers simultaneously to both the Twelve Branches and their corresponding Twelve Generals, and strictly speaking, labeling Jūni Tenshō as Jūni Shinshō is incorrect. ==List== {{ill|Abe no Seimei|en|安倍晴明|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Abe no Seimei|qq=}}, a renowned [[:en:Onmyōji|Onmyōji]], in Chapter 4 of his work "Senji Ryakuketsu" (占事略决), explains the characteristics associated with each of the Twelve Generals as follows: {{Quotation| '''Former Deities (前):''' * '''First:''' The Soaring Snake, Fire Deity resides in *Si (巳)* – governs fear, terror, and ominous generals (凶将). * '''Second:''' The Vermilion Bird, Fire Deity resides in *Wu (午)* – governs disputes, arguments, and official entanglements (凶将). * '''Third:''' The Six Harmonies, Wood Deity resides in *Mao (卯)* – governs secrecy and harmony, auspicious generals (吉将). * '''Fourth:''' The Hooked Chen, Earth Deity resides in *Chen (辰)* – governs battles, lawsuits, and strife (凶将). * '''Fifth:''' The Azure Dragon, Wood Deity resides in *Yin (寅)* – governs wealth, fortune, and celebration (吉将). * '''Heavenly Nobleman:''' Supreme Deity resides in *Chou (丑)* – governs blessings and virtue, deity of good fortune (吉将), but ends with "Great Nothingness Achieved" (大无成 – possibly an idiom or esoteric phrase meaning culmination or void success). --- '''Later Deities (後):''' * '''First:''' The Queen of Heaven, Water Deity resides in *Hai (亥)* – governs the inner palace and women, auspicious general (吉将). * '''Second:''' The Great Yin, Metal Deity resides in *You (酉)* – governs secrets, concealment, and hidden matters (吉将). * '''Third:''' The Black Tortoise, Water Deity resides in *Zi (子)* – governs loss, theft, and banditry (凶将). * '''Fourth:''' The Great Skirt, Earth Deity resides in *Wei (未)* – governs clothing, robes, and ceremonial dress (吉将). * '''Fifth:''' The White Tiger, Metal Deity resides in *Shen (申)* – governs illness and death (凶将). * '''Sixth:''' The Sky Void, Earth Deity resides in *Xu (戌)* – governs deception, danger, and mistrust (凶将). }} ("Names Reference: Nihon Onmyōdōshi Sōsetsu") The above information is organized below, {{Infobox deity}}{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[Category:Has wikidata]][[d:Q10904413]] Wikidata name: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 10:11, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{afc comment|1=Apparently different from {{ill|Twelve Heavenly Generals|en|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Twelve Heavenly Generals|qq=}} Here's your translation with proper use of the "{{ill|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/qq=|qq=}}" template: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 18:09, 3 March 2025 (UTC)|qq=draft|qq=}} {{Unreferenced|date=August 2018|qq=}} '''Jūni Tenshō''' (十二天将, lit. Twelve Heavenly Generals) refers to a symbolic system used within the [[:en:Daliuren|Rokujin Shinka]] divination method, which was essential for [[:en:Onmyōji|Onmyōji]] practitioners such as {{ill|Abe no Seimei|en|安倍晴明|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Abe no Seimei|qq=}}. Originating from constellations centered around the {{ill|Polaris|en|北極星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Polaris|qq=}}, each corresponds to principles of {{ill|Yin-Yang and the Five Elements|en|陰陽五行思想|1=Yin-Yang and Wuxing Theory|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yin-Yang and the Five Elements|qq=}}. Although frequently called [[:en:Twelve Heavenly Generals|Jūni Shinshō]], Jūni Tenshō differs significantly from the Buddhist [[:en:Twelve Devas|Twelve Devas]] and {{ill|Twelve Heavenly Generals|en|十二神将|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Twelve Heavenly Generals|qq=}}. In traditional texts like "Rokujin Yaku," the term "Kami" (神) refers specifically to the twelve Earthly Branches (十二支) placed on the heavenly board (天盤), and "Shō" (将) denotes the Twelve Heavenly Generals themselves. Therefore, "Kami-Shō" (神将) refers simultaneously to both the Twelve Branches and their corresponding Twelve Generals, and strictly speaking, labeling Jūni Tenshō as Jūni Shinshō is incorrect. ==List== {{ill|Abe no Seimei|en|安倍晴明|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Abe no Seimei|qq=}}, a renowned [[:en:Onmyōji|Onmyōji]], in Chapter 4 of his work "Senji Ryakuketsu" (占事略决), explains the characteristics associated with each of the Twelve Generals as follows: {{Quotation| '''Former Deities (前):''' * '''First:''' The Soaring Snake, Fire Deity resides in *Si (巳)* – governs fear, terror, and ominous generals (凶将). * '''Second:''' The Vermilion Bird, Fire Deity resides in *Wu (午)* – governs disputes, arguments, and official entanglements (凶将). * '''Third:''' The Six Harmonies, Wood Deity resides in *Mao (卯)* – governs secrecy and harmony, auspicious generals (吉将). * '''Fourth:''' The Hooked Chen, Earth Deity resides in *Chen (辰)* – governs battles, lawsuits, and strife (凶将). * '''Fifth:''' The Azure Dragon, Wood Deity resides in *Yin (寅)* – governs wealth, fortune, and celebration (吉将). * '''Heavenly Nobleman:''' Supreme Deity resides in *Chou (丑)* – governs blessings and virtue, deity of good fortune (吉将), but ends with "Great Nothingness Achieved" (大无成 – possibly an idiom or esoteric phrase meaning culmination or void success). --- '''Later Deities (後):''' * '''First:''' The Queen of Heaven, Water Deity resides in *Hai (亥)* – governs the inner palace and women, auspicious general (吉将). * '''Second:''' The Great Yin, Metal Deity resides in *You (酉)* – governs secrets, concealment, and hidden matters (吉将). * '''Third:''' The Black Tortoise, Water Deity resides in *Zi (子)* – governs loss, theft, and banditry (凶将). * '''Fourth:''' The Great Skirt, Earth Deity resides in *Wei (未)* – governs clothing, robes, and ceremonial dress (吉将). * '''Fifth:''' The White Tiger, Metal Deity resides in *Shen (申)* – governs illness and death (凶将). * '''Sixth:''' The Sky Void, Earth Deity resides in *Xu (戌)* – governs deception, danger, and mistrust (凶将). }} ("Names Reference: Nihon Onmyōdōshi Sōsetsu") The above information is organized below, {{Infobox deity}}{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[Category:Has wikidata]][[d:Q10904413]] Wikidata name: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 10:11, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{afc comment|1=Apparently different from {{ill|Twelve Heavenly Generals|en|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Twelve Heavenly Generals|qq=}} Here's your translation with proper use of the "{{ill|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/qq=|qq=}}" template: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 18:09, 3 March 2025 (UTC)|qq=draft|qq=}} {{Unreferenced|date=August 2018|qq=}} '''Jūni Tenshō''' (十二天将, lit. Twelve Heavenly Generals) refers to a symbolic system used within the [[:en:Daliuren|Rokujin Shinka]] divination method, which was essential for [[:en:Onmyōji|Onmyōji]] practitioners such as {{ill|Abe no Seimei|en|安倍晴明|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Abe no Seimei|qq=}}. Originating from constellations centered around the {{ill|Polaris|en|北極星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Polaris|qq=}}, each corresponds to principles of {{ill|Yin-Yang and the Five Elements|en|陰陽五行思想|1=Yin-Yang and Wuxing Theory|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yin-Yang and the Five Elements|qq=}}. Although frequently called [[:en:Twelve Heavenly Generals|Jūni Shinshō]], Jūni Tenshō differs significantly from the Buddhist [[:en:Twelve Devas|Twelve Devas]] and {{ill|Twelve Heavenly Generals|en|十二神将|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Twelve Heavenly Generals|qq=}}. In traditional texts like "Rokujin Yaku," the term "Kami" (神) refers specifically to the twelve Earthly Branches (十二支) placed on the heavenly board (天盤), and "Shō" (将) denotes the Twelve Heavenly Generals themselves. Therefore, "Kami-Shō" (神将) refers simultaneously to both the Twelve Branches and their corresponding Twelve Generals, and strictly speaking, labeling Jūni Tenshō as Jūni Shinshō is incorrect. ==List== {{ill|Abe no Seimei|en|安倍晴明|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Abe no Seimei|qq=}}, a renowned [[:en:Onmyōji|Onmyōji]], in Chapter 4 of his work "Senji Ryakuketsu" (占事略决), explains the characteristics associated with each of the Twelve Generals as follows: {{Quotation| '''Former Deities (前):''' * '''First:''' The Soaring Snake, Fire Deity resides in *Si (巳)* – governs fear, terror, and ominous generals (凶将). * '''Second:''' The Vermilion Bird, Fire Deity resides in *Wu (午)* – governs disputes, arguments, and official entanglements (凶将). * '''Third:''' The Six Harmonies, Wood Deity resides in *Mao (卯)* – governs secrecy and harmony, auspicious generals (吉将). * '''Fourth:''' The Hooked Chen, Earth Deity resides in *Chen (辰)* – governs battles, lawsuits, and strife (凶将). * '''Fifth:''' The Azure Dragon, Wood Deity resides in *Yin (寅)* – governs wealth, fortune, and celebration (吉将). * '''Heavenly Nobleman:''' Supreme Deity resides in *Chou (丑)* – governs blessings and virtue, deity of good fortune (吉将), but ends with "Great Nothingness Achieved" (大无成 – possibly an idiom or esoteric phrase meaning culmination or void success). --- '''Later Deities (後):''' * '''First:''' The Queen of Heaven, Water Deity resides in *Hai (亥)* – governs the inner palace and women, auspicious general (吉将). * '''Second:''' The Great Yin, Metal Deity resides in *You (酉)* – governs secrets, concealment, and hidden matters (吉将). * '''Third:''' The Black Tortoise, Water Deity resides in *Zi (子)* – governs loss, theft, and banditry (凶将). * '''Fourth:''' The Great Skirt, Earth Deity resides in *Wei (未)* – governs clothing, robes, and ceremonial dress (吉将). * '''Fifth:''' The White Tiger, Metal Deity resides in *Shen (申)* – governs illness and death (凶将). * '''Sixth:''' The Sky Void, Earth Deity resides in *Xu (戌)* – governs deception, danger, and mistrust (凶将). }} ("Names Reference: Nihon Onmyōdōshi Sōsetsu") The above information is organized below, with aliases included: # [[:en:Teng (mythology)|Tōda (Twelve Heavenly Generals)]] (Fire, Southeast, Snake, Fear, Inauspicious) # {{ill|Suzaku|en|朱雀|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Suzaku|qq=}} (Fire, South, Arguments, Inauspicious) # {{ill|Rikugō|ja|六合 (十二天将)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Rikugō|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} (Wood, East, Harmony, Auspicious) # {{ill|Kōchin|ja|勾陳|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōchin|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} (Earth, Southeast, Conflict, Inauspicious) # [[ja:十二天将]][[zh:十二天將]] {{Infobox deity}}{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[Category:Has wikidata]][[d:Q10904413]] Wikidata name: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 10:11, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{afc comment|1=Apparently different from {{ill|Twelve Heavenly Generals|en|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Twelve Heavenly Generals|qq=}} Here's your translation with proper use of the "{{ill|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/qq=|qq=}}" template: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 18:09, 3 March 2025 (UTC)|qq=draft|qq=}} {{Unreferenced|date=August 2018|qq=}} '''Jūni Tenshō''' (十二天将, lit. Twelve Heavenly Generals) refers to a symbolic system used within the [[:en:Daliuren|Rokujin Shinka]] divination method, which was essential for [[:en:Onmyōji|Onmyōji]] practitioners such as {{ill|Abe no Seimei|en|安倍晴明|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Abe no Seimei|qq=}}. Originating from constellations centered around the {{ill|Polaris|en|北極星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Polaris|qq=}}, each corresponds to principles of {{ill|Yin-Yang and the Five Elements|en|陰陽五行思想|1=Yin-Yang and Wuxing Theory|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yin-Yang and the Five Elements|qq=}}. Although frequently called [[:en:Twelve Heavenly Generals|Jūni Shinshō]], Jūni Tenshō differs significantly from the Buddhist [[:en:Twelve Devas|Twelve Devas]] and {{ill|Twelve Heavenly Generals|en|十二神将|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Twelve Heavenly Generals|qq=}}. In traditional texts like "Rokujin Yaku," the term "Kami" (神) refers specifically to the twelve Earthly Branches (十二支) placed on the heavenly board (天盤), and "Shō" (将) denotes the Twelve Heavenly Generals themselves. Therefore, "Kami-Shō" (神将) refers simultaneously to both the Twelve Branches and their corresponding Twelve Generals, and strictly speaking, labeling Jūni Tenshō as Jūni Shinshō is incorrect. ==List== {{ill|Abe no Seimei|en|安倍晴明|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Abe no Seimei|qq=}}, a renowned [[:en:Onmyōji|Onmyōji]], in Chapter 4 of his work "Senji Ryakuketsu" (占事略决), explains the characteristics associated with each of the Twelve Generals as follows: {{Quotation| '''Former Deities (前):''' * '''First:''' The Soaring Snake, Fire Deity resides in *Si (巳)* – governs fear, terror, and ominous generals (凶将). * '''Second:''' The Vermilion Bird, Fire Deity resides in *Wu (午)* – governs disputes, arguments, and official entanglements (凶将). * '''Third:''' The Six Harmonies, Wood Deity resides in *Mao (卯)* – governs secrecy and harmony, auspicious generals (吉将). * '''Fourth:''' The Hooked Chen, Earth Deity resides in *Chen (辰)* – governs battles, lawsuits, and strife (凶将). * '''Fifth:''' The Azure Dragon, Wood Deity resides in *Yin (寅)* – governs wealth, fortune, and celebration (吉将). * '''Heavenly Nobleman:''' Supreme Deity resides in *Chou (丑)* – governs blessings and virtue, deity of good fortune (吉将), but ends with "Great Nothingness Achieved" (大无成 – possibly an idiom or esoteric phrase meaning culmination or void success). --- '''Later Deities (後):''' * '''First:''' The Queen of Heaven, Water Deity resides in *Hai (亥)* – governs the inner palace and women, auspicious general (吉将). * '''Second:''' The Great Yin, Metal Deity resides in *You (酉)* – governs secrets, concealment, and hidden matters (吉将). * '''Third:''' The Black Tortoise, Water Deity resides in *Zi (子)* – governs loss, theft, and banditry (凶将). * '''Fourth:''' The Great Skirt, Earth Deity resides in *Wei (未)* – governs clothing, robes, and ceremonial dress (吉将). * '''Fifth:''' The White Tiger, Metal Deity resides in *Shen (申)* – governs illness and death (凶将). * '''Sixth:''' The Sky Void, Earth Deity resides in *Xu (戌)* – governs deception, danger, and mistrust (凶将). }} ("Names Reference: Nihon Onmyōdōshi Sōsetsu") The above information is organized below, [[ja:十二天将]][[zh:十二天將]] {{Infobox deity}}{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[Category:Has wikidata]][[d:Q10904413]] Wikidata name: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 10:11, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{afc comment|1=Apparently different from {{ill|Twelve Heavenly Generals|en|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Twelve Heavenly Generals|qq=}} Here's your translation with proper use of the "{{ill|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/qq=|qq=}}" template: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 18:09, 3 March 2025 (UTC)|qq=draft|qq=}} {{Unreferenced|date=August 2018|qq=}} '''Jūni Tenshō''' (十二天将, lit. Twelve Heavenly Generals) refers to a symbolic system used within the [[:en:Daliuren|Rokujin Shinka]] divination method, which was essential for [[:en:Onmyōji|Onmyōji]] practitioners such as {{ill|Abe no Seimei|en|安倍晴明|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Abe no Seimei|qq=}}. Originating from constellations centered around the {{ill|Polaris|en|北極星|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Polaris|qq=}}, each corresponds to principles of {{ill|Yin-Yang and the Five Elements|en|陰陽五行思想|1=Yin-Yang and Wuxing Theory|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yin-Yang and the Five Elements|qq=}}. Although frequently called [[:en:Twelve Heavenly Generals|Jūni Shinshō]], Jūni Tenshō differs significantly from the Buddhist [[:en:Twelve Devas|Twelve Devas]] and {{ill|Twelve Heavenly Generals|en|十二神将|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Twelve Heavenly Generals|qq=}}. In traditional texts like "Rokujin Yaku," the term "Kami" (神) refers specifically to the twelve Earthly Branches (十二支) placed on the heavenly board (天盤), and "Shō" (将) denotes the Twelve Heavenly Generals themselves. Therefore, "Kami-Shō" (神将) refers simultaneously to both the Twelve Branches and their corresponding Twelve Generals, and strictly speaking, labeling Jūni Tenshō as Jūni Shinshō is incorrect. ==List== {{ill|Abe no Seimei|en|安倍晴明|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Abe no Seimei|qq=}}, a renowned [[:en:Onmyōji|Onmyōji]], in Chapter 4 of his work "Senji Ryakuketsu" (占事略决), explains the characteristics associated with each of the Twelve Generals as follows: {{Quotation| '''Former Deities (前):''' * '''First:''' The Soaring Snake, Fire Deity resides in *Si (巳)* – governs fear, terror, and ominous generals (凶将). * '''Second:''' The Vermilion Bird, Fire Deity resides in *Wu (午)* – governs disputes, arguments, and official entanglements (凶将). * '''Third:''' The Six Harmonies, Wood Deity resides in *Mao (卯)* – governs secrecy and harmony, auspicious generals (吉将). * '''Fourth:''' The Hooked Chen, Earth Deity resides in *Chen (辰)* – governs battles, lawsuits, and strife (凶将). * '''Fifth:''' The Azure Dragon, Wood Deity resides in *Yin (寅)* – governs wealth, fortune, and celebration (吉将). * '''Heavenly Nobleman:''' Supreme Deity resides in *Chou (丑)* – governs blessings and virtue, deity of good fortune (吉将), but ends with "Great Nothingness Achieved" (大无成 – possibly an idiom or esoteric phrase meaning culmination or void success). --- '''Later Deities (後):''' * '''First:''' The Queen of Heaven, Water Deity resides in *Hai (亥)* – governs the inner palace and women, auspicious general (吉将). * '''Second:''' The Great Yin, Metal Deity resides in *You (酉)* – governs secrets, concealment, and hidden matters (吉将). * '''Third:''' The Black Tortoise, Water Deity resides in *Zi (子)* – governs loss, theft, and banditry (凶将). * '''Fourth:''' The Great Skirt, Earth Deity resides in *Wei (未)* – governs clothing, robes, and ceremonial dress (吉将). * '''Fifth:''' The White Tiger, Metal Deity resides in *Shen (申)* – governs illness and death (凶将). * '''Sixth:''' The Sky Void, Earth Deity resides in *Xu (戌)* – governs deception, danger, and mistrust (凶将). }} ("Names Reference: Nihon Onmyōdōshi Sōsetsu") The above information is organized below, [[ja:十二天将]][[zh:十二天將]] {{Infobox deity}}{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[Category:Has wikidata]][[d:Q10904413]] Wikidata name: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 10:11, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{afc comment|1=Apparently different from {{ill|Twelve Heavenly Generals|en|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Twelve Heavenly Generals|qq=}} Here's your translation with proper use of the "{{ill|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/qq=|qq=}}" template: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 18:09, 3 March 2025 (UTC)|qq=}} {{Unreferenced|date=August 2018|qq=}} '''Jūni Tenshō''' (十二天将, lit. Twelve Heavenly Generals) refers to a symbolic system used within the [[:en:Daliuren|Rokujin Shinka]] divination method, which was essential for [[:en:Onmyōji|Onmyōji]] practitioners such as {{ill|Abe no Seimei|en|安倍晴明|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Abe no Seimei|qq=}}. Originating from constellations centered around the {{ill|Polaris|en|北極星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Polaris|qq=}}, each corresponds to principles of {{ill|Yin-Yang and the Five Elements|en|陰陽五行思想|1=Yin-Yang and Wuxing Theory|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yin-Yang and the Five Elements|qq=}}. Although frequently called [[:en:Twelve Heavenly Generals|Jūni Shinshō]], Jūni Tenshō differs significantly from the Buddhist [[:en:Twelve Devas|Twelve Devas]] and {{ill|Twelve Heavenly Generals|en|十二神将|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Twelve Heavenly Generals|qq=}}. In traditional texts like "Rokujin Yaku," the term "Kami" (神) refers specifically to the twelve Earthly Branches (十二支) placed on the heavenly board (天盤), and "Shō" (将) denotes the Twelve Heavenly Generals themselves. Therefore, "Kami-Shō" (神将) refers simultaneously to both the Twelve Branches and their corresponding Twelve Generals, and strictly speaking, labeling Jūni Tenshō as Jūni Shinshō is incorrect. ==List== {{ill|Abe no Seimei|en|安倍晴明|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Abe no Seimei|qq=}}, a renowned [[:en:Onmyōji|Onmyōji]], in Chapter 4 of his work "Senji Ryakuketsu" (占事略决), explains the characteristics associated with each of the Twelve Generals as follows: {{Quotation| '''Former Deities (前):''' * '''First:''' The Soaring Snake, Fire Deity resides in *Si (巳)* – governs fear, terror, and ominous generals (凶将). * '''Second:''' The Vermilion Bird, Fire Deity resides in *Wu (午)* – governs disputes, arguments, and official entanglements (凶将). * '''Third:''' The Six Harmonies, Wood Deity resides in *Mao (卯)* – governs secrecy and harmony, auspicious generals (吉将). * '''Fourth:''' The Hooked Chen, Earth Deity resides in *Chen (辰)* – governs battles, lawsuits, and strife (凶将). * '''Fifth:''' The Azure Dragon, Wood Deity resides in *Yin (寅)* – governs wealth, fortune, and celebration (吉将). * '''Heavenly Nobleman:''' Supreme Deity resides in *Chou (丑)* – governs blessings and virtue, deity of good fortune (吉将), but ends with "Great Nothingness Achieved" (大无成 – possibly an idiom or esoteric phrase meaning culmination or void success). --- '''Later Deities (後):''' * '''First:''' The Queen of Heaven, Water Deity resides in *Hai (亥)* – governs the inner palace and women, auspicious general (吉将). * '''Second:''' The Great Yin, Metal Deity resides in *You (酉)* – governs secrets, concealment, and hidden matters (吉将). * '''Third:''' The Black Tortoise, Water Deity resides in *Zi (子)* – governs loss, theft, and banditry (凶将). * '''Fourth:''' The Great Skirt, Earth Deity resides in *Wei (未)* – governs clothing, robes, and ceremonial dress (吉将). * '''Fifth:''' The White Tiger, Metal Deity resides in *Shen (申)* – governs illness and death (凶将). * '''Sixth:''' The Sky Void, Earth Deity resides in *Xu (戌)* – governs deception, danger, and mistrust (凶将). }} ("Names Reference: Nihon Onmyōdōshi Sōsetsu") The above information is organized below, with aliases included: # [[ja:十二天将]][[zh:十二天將]] {{Infobox deity}}{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[Category:Has wikidata]][[d:Q10904413]] Wikidata name: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 10:11, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{afc comment|1=Apparently different from {{ill|Twelve Heavenly Generals|en|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Twelve Heavenly Generals|qq=}} Here's your translation with proper use of the "{{ill|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/qq=|qq=}}" template: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 18:09, 3 March 2025 (UTC)|qq=}} {{Unreferenced|date=August 2018|qq=}} '''Jūni Tenshō''' (十二天将, lit. Twelve Heavenly Generals) refers to a symbolic system used within the [[:en:Daliuren|Rokujin Shinka]] divination method, which was essential for [[:en:Onmyōji|Onmyōji]] practitioners such as {{ill|Abe no Seimei|en|安倍晴明|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Abe no Seimei|qq=}}. Originating from constellations centered around the {{ill|Polaris|en|北極星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Polaris|qq=}}, each corresponds to principles of {{ill|Yin-Yang and the Five Elements|en|陰陽五行思想|1=Yin-Yang and Wuxing Theory|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yin-Yang and the Five Elements|qq=}}. Although frequently called [[:en:Twelve Heavenly Generals|Jūni Shinshō]], Jūni Tenshō differs significantly from the Buddhist [[:en:Twelve Devas|Twelve Devas]] and {{ill|Twelve Heavenly Generals|en|十二神将|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Twelve Heavenly Generals|qq=}}. In traditional texts like "Rokujin Yaku," the term "Kami" (神) refers specifically to the twelve Earthly Branches (十二支) placed on the heavenly board (天盤), and "Shō" (将) denotes the Twelve Heavenly Generals themselves. Therefore, "Kami-Shō" (神将) refers simultaneously to both the Twelve Branches and their corresponding Twelve Generals, and strictly speaking, labeling Jūni Tenshō as Jūni Shinshō is incorrect. ==List== {{ill|Abe no Seimei|en|安倍晴明|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Abe no Seimei|qq=}}, a renowned [[:en:Onmyōji|Onmyōji]], in Chapter 4 of his work "Senji Ryakuketsu" (占事略决), explains the characteristics associated with each of the Twelve Generals as follows: {{Quotation| '''Former Deities (前):''' * '''First:''' The Soaring Snake, Fire Deity resides in *Si (巳)* – governs fear, terror, and ominous generals (凶将). * '''Second:''' The Vermilion Bird, Fire Deity resides in *Wu (午)* – governs disputes, arguments, and official entanglements (凶将). * '''Third:''' The Six Harmonies, Wood Deity resides in *Mao (卯)* – governs secrecy and harmony, auspicious generals (吉将). * '''Fourth:''' The Hooked Chen, Earth Deity resides in *Chen (辰)* – governs battles, lawsuits, and strife (凶将). * '''Fifth:''' The Azure Dragon, Wood Deity resides in *Yin (寅)* – governs wealth, fortune, and celebration (吉将). * '''Heavenly Nobleman:''' Supreme Deity resides in *Chou (丑)* – governs blessings and virtue, deity of good fortune (吉将), but ends with "Great Nothingness Achieved" (大无成 – possibly an idiom or esoteric phrase meaning culmination or void success). --- '''Later Deities (後):''' * '''First:''' The Queen of Heaven, Water Deity resides in *Hai (亥)* – governs the inner palace and women, auspicious general (吉将). * '''Second:''' The Great Yin, Metal Deity resides in *You (酉)* – governs secrets, concealment, and hidden matters (吉将). * '''Third:''' The Black Tortoise, Water Deity resides in *Zi (子)* – governs loss, theft, and banditry (凶将). * '''Fourth:''' The Great Skirt, Earth Deity resides in *Wei (未)* – governs clothing, robes, and ceremonial dress (吉将). * '''Fifth:''' The White Tiger, Metal Deity resides in *Shen (申)* – governs illness and death (凶将). * '''Sixth:''' The Sky Void, Earth Deity resides in *Xu (戌)* – governs deception, danger, and mistrust (凶将). }} ("Names Reference: Nihon Onmyōdōshi Sōsetsu") The above information is organized below, with aliases included: # [[ja:十二天将]][[zh:十二天將]] {{Infobox deity}}{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[Category:Has wikidata]][[d:Q10904413]] Wikidata name: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 10:11, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{afc comment|1=Apparently different from {{ill|Twelve Heavenly Generals|en|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Twelve Heavenly Generals|qq=}} Here's your translation with proper use of the "{{ill|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/qq=|qq=}}" template: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 18:09, 3 March 2025 (UTC)|qq=}} {{Unreferenced|date=August 2018|qq=}} '''Jūni Tenshō''' (十二天将, lit. Twelve Heavenly Generals) refers to a symbolic system used within the [[:en:Daliuren|Rokujin Shinka]] divination method, which was essential for [[:en:Onmyōji|Onmyōji]] practitioners such as {{ill|Abe no Seimei|en|安倍晴明|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Abe no Seimei|qq=}}. Originating from constellations centered around the {{ill|Polaris|en|北極星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Polaris|qq=}}, each corresponds to principles of {{ill|Yin-Yang and the Five Elements|en|陰陽五行思想|1=Yin-Yang and Wuxing Theory|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yin-Yang and the Five Elements|qq=}}. Although frequently called [[:en:Twelve Heavenly Generals|Jūni Shinshō]], Jūni Tenshō differs significantly from the Buddhist [[:en:Twelve Devas|Twelve Devas]] and {{ill|Twelve Heavenly Generals|en|十二神将|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Twelve Heavenly Generals|qq=}}. In traditional texts like "Rokujin Yaku," the term "Kami" (神) refers specifically to the twelve Earthly Branches (十二支) placed on the heavenly board (天盤), and "Shō" (将) denotes the Twelve Heavenly Generals themselves. Therefore, "Kami-Shō" (神将) refers simultaneously to both the Twelve Branches and their corresponding Twelve Generals, and strictly speaking, labeling Jūni Tenshō as Jūni Shinshō is incorrect. ==List== {{ill|Abe no Seimei|en|安倍晴明|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Abe no Seimei|qq=}}, a renowned [[:en:Onmyōji|Onmyōji]], in Chapter 4 of his work "Senji Ryakuketsu" (占事略决), explains the characteristics associated with each of the Twelve Generals as follows: {{Quotation| '''Former Deities (前):''' * '''First:''' The Soaring Snake, Fire Deity resides in *Si (巳)* – governs fear, terror, and ominous generals (凶将). * '''Second:''' The Vermilion Bird, Fire Deity resides in *Wu (午)* – governs disputes, arguments, and official entanglements (凶将). * '''Third:''' The Six Harmonies, Wood Deity resides in *Mao (卯)* – governs secrecy and harmony, auspicious generals (吉将). * '''Fourth:''' The Hooked Chen, Earth Deity resides in *Chen (辰)* – governs battles, lawsuits, and strife (凶将). * '''Fifth:''' The Azure Dragon, Wood Deity resides in *Yin (寅)* – governs wealth, fortune, and celebration (吉将). * '''Heavenly Nobleman:''' Supreme Deity resides in *Chou (丑)* – governs blessings and virtue, deity of good fortune (吉将), but ends with "Great Nothingness Achieved" (大无成 – possibly an idiom or esoteric phrase meaning culmination or void success). --- '''Later Deities (後):''' * '''First:''' The Queen of Heaven, Water Deity resides in *Hai (亥)* – governs the inner palace and women, auspicious general (吉将). * '''Second:''' The Great Yin, Metal Deity resides in *You (酉)* – governs secrets, concealment, and hidden matters (吉将). * '''Third:''' The Black Tortoise, Water Deity resides in *Zi (子)* – governs loss, theft, and banditry (凶将). * '''Fourth:''' The Great Skirt, Earth Deity resides in *Wei (未)* – governs clothing, robes, and ceremonial dress (吉将). * '''Fifth:''' The White Tiger, Metal Deity resides in *Shen (申)* – governs illness and death (凶将). * '''Sixth:''' The Sky Void, Earth Deity resides in *Xu (戌)* – governs deception, danger, and mistrust (凶将). }} ("Names Reference: Nihon Onmyōdōshi Sōsetsu") The above information is organized below, with aliases included: # [[ja:十二天将]][[zh:十二天將]] {{Infobox deity}}{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[Category:Has wikidata]][[d:Q10904413]] Wikidata name: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 10:11, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{afc comment|1=Apparently different from {{ill|Twelve Heavenly Generals|en|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Twelve Heavenly Generals|qq=}} Here's your translation with proper use of the "{{ill|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/qq=|qq=}}" template: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 18:09, 3 March 2025 (UTC)|qq=}} {{Unreferenced|date=August 2018|qq=}} '''Jūni Tenshō''' (十二天将, lit. Twelve Heavenly Generals) refers to a symbolic system used within the [[:en:Daliuren|Rokujin Shinka]] divination method, which was essential for [[:en:Onmyōji|Onmyōji]] practitioners such as {{ill|Abe no Seimei|en|安倍晴明|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Abe no Seimei|qq=}}. Originating from constellations centered around the {{ill|Polaris|en|北極星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Polaris|qq=}}, each corresponds to principles of {{ill|Yin-Yang and the Five Elements|en|陰陽五行思想|1=Yin-Yang and Wuxing Theory|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yin-Yang and the Five Elements|qq=}}. Although frequently called [[:en:Twelve Heavenly Generals|Jūni Shinshō]], Jūni Tenshō differs significantly from the Buddhist [[:en:Twelve Devas|Twelve Devas]] and {{ill|Twelve Heavenly Generals|en|十二神将|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Twelve Heavenly Generals|qq=}}. In traditional texts like "Rokujin Yaku," the term "Kami" (神) refers specifically to the twelve Earthly Branches (十二支) placed on the heavenly board (天盤), and "Shō" (将) denotes the Twelve Heavenly Generals themselves. Therefore, "Kami-Shō" (神将) refers simultaneously to both the Twelve Branches and their corresponding Twelve Generals, and strictly speaking, labeling Jūni Tenshō as Jūni Shinshō is incorrect. ==List== {{ill|Abe no Seimei|en|安倍晴明|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Abe no Seimei|qq=}}, a renowned [[:en:Onmyōji|Onmyōji]], in Chapter 4 of his work "Senji Ryakuketsu" (占事略决), explains the characteristics associated with each of the Twelve Generals as follows: {{Quotation| '''Former Deities (前):''' * '''First:''' The Soaring Snake, Fire Deity resides in *Si (巳)* – governs fear, terror, and ominous generals (凶将). * '''Second:''' The Vermilion Bird, Fire Deity resides in *Wu (午)* – governs disputes, arguments, and official entanglements (凶将). * '''Third:''' The Six Harmonies, Wood Deity resides in *Mao (卯)* – governs secrecy and harmony, auspicious generals (吉将). * '''Fourth:''' The Hooked Chen, Earth Deity resides in *Chen (辰)* – governs battles, lawsuits, and strife (凶将). * '''Fifth:''' The Azure Dragon, Wood Deity resides in *Yin (寅)* – governs wealth, fortune, and celebration (吉将). * '''Heavenly Nobleman:''' Supreme Deity resides in *Chou (丑)* – governs blessings and virtue, deity of good fortune (吉将), but ends with "Great Nothingness Achieved" (大无成 – possibly an idiom or esoteric phrase meaning culmination or void success). --- '''Later Deities (後):''' * '''First:''' The Queen of Heaven, Water Deity resides in *Hai (亥)* – governs the inner palace and women, auspicious general (吉将). * '''Second:''' The Great Yin, Metal Deity resides in *You (酉)* – governs secrets, concealment, and hidden matters (吉将). * '''Third:''' The Black Tortoise, Water Deity resides in *Zi (子)* – governs loss, theft, and banditry (凶将). * '''Fourth:''' The Great Skirt, Earth Deity resides in *Wei (未)* – governs clothing, robes, and ceremonial dress (吉将). * '''Fifth:''' The White Tiger, Metal Deity resides in *Shen (申)* – governs illness and death (凶将). * '''Sixth:''' The Sky Void, Earth Deity resides in *Xu (戌)* – governs deception, danger, and mistrust (凶将). }} ("Names Reference: Nihon Onmyōdōshi Sōsetsu") The above information is organized below, with aliases included: # [[ja:十二天将]][[zh:十二天將]] {{Infobox deity}}{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[Category:Has wikidata]][[d:Q10904413]] Wikidata name: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 10:11, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{afc comment|1=Apparently different from {{ill|Twelve Heavenly Generals|en|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Twelve Heavenly Generals|qq=}} Here's your translation with proper use of the "{{ill|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/qq=|qq=}}" template: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 18:09, 3 March 2025 (UTC)|qq=}} {{Unreferenced|date=August 2018|qq=}} '''Jūni Tenshō''' (十二天将, lit. Twelve Heavenly Generals) refers to a symbolic system used within the [[:en:Daliuren|Rokujin Shinka]] divination method, which was essential for [[:en:Onmyōji|Onmyōji]] practitioners such as {{ill|Abe no Seimei|en|安倍晴明|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Abe no Seimei|qq=}}. Originating from constellations centered around the {{ill|Polaris|en|北極星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Polaris|qq=}}, each corresponds to principles of {{ill|Yin-Yang and the Five Elements|en|陰陽五行思想|1=Yin-Yang and Wuxing Theory|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yin-Yang and the Five Elements|qq=}}. Although frequently called [[:en:Twelve Heavenly Generals|Jūni Shinshō]], Jūni Tenshō differs significantly from the Buddhist [[:en:Twelve Devas|Twelve Devas]] and {{ill|Twelve Heavenly Generals|en|十二神将|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Twelve Heavenly Generals|qq=}}. In traditional texts like "Rokujin Yaku," the term "Kami" (神) refers specifically to the twelve Earthly Branches (十二支) placed on the heavenly board (天盤), and "Shō" (将) denotes the Twelve Heavenly Generals themselves. Therefore, "Kami-Shō" (神将) refers simultaneously to both the Twelve Branches and their corresponding Twelve Generals, and strictly speaking, labeling Jūni Tenshō as Jūni Shinshō is incorrect. ==List== {{ill|Abe no Seimei|en|安倍晴明|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Abe no Seimei|qq=}}, a renowned [[:en:Onmyōji|Onmyōji]], in Chapter 4 of his work "Senji Ryakuketsu" (占事略决), explains the characteristics associated with each of the Twelve Generals as follows: {{Quotation| '''Former Deities (前):''' * '''First:''' The Soaring Snake, Fire Deity resides in *Si (巳)* – governs fear, terror, and ominous generals (凶将). * '''Second:''' The Vermilion Bird, Fire Deity resides in *Wu (午)* – governs disputes, arguments, and official entanglements (凶将). * '''Third:''' The Six Harmonies, Wood Deity resides in *Mao (卯)* – governs secrecy and harmony, auspicious generals (吉将). * '''Fourth:''' The Hooked Chen, Earth Deity resides in *Chen (辰)* – governs battles, lawsuits, and strife (凶将). * '''Fifth:''' The Azure Dragon, Wood Deity resides in *Yin (寅)* – governs wealth, fortune, and celebration (吉将). * '''Heavenly Nobleman:''' Supreme Deity resides in *Chou (丑)* – governs blessings and virtue, deity of good fortune (吉将), but ends with "Great Nothingness Achieved" (大无成 – possibly an idiom or esoteric phrase meaning culmination or void success). --- '''Later Deities (後):''' * '''First:''' The Queen of Heaven, Water Deity resides in *Hai (亥)* – governs the inner palace and women, auspicious general (吉将). * '''Second:''' The Great Yin, Metal Deity resides in *You (酉)* – governs secrets, concealment, and hidden matters (吉将). * '''Third:''' The Black Tortoise, Water Deity resides in *Zi (子)* – governs loss, theft, and banditry (凶将). * '''Fourth:''' The Great Skirt, Earth Deity resides in *Wei (未)* – governs clothing, robes, and ceremonial dress (吉将). * '''Fifth:''' The White Tiger, Metal Deity resides in *Shen (申)* – governs illness and death (凶将). * '''Sixth:''' The Sky Void, Earth Deity resides in *Xu (戌)* – governs deception, danger, and mistrust (凶将). }} ("Names Reference: Nihon Onmyōdōshi Sōsetsu") The above information is organized below, with aliases included: # [[ja:十二天将]][[zh:十二天將]] {{Infobox deity}}{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[Category:Has wikidata]][[d:Q10904413]] Wikidata name: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 10:11, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{afc comment|1=Apparently different from {{ill|Twelve Heavenly Generals|en|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Twelve Heavenly Generals|qq=}} Here's your translation with proper use of the "{{ill|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/qq=|qq=}}" template: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 18:09, 3 March 2025 (UTC)|qq=}} {{Unreferenced|date=August 2018|qq=}} '''Jūni Tenshō''' (十二天将, lit. Twelve Heavenly Generals) refers to a symbolic system used within the [[:en:Daliuren|Rokujin Shinka]] divination method, which was essential for [[:en:Onmyōji|Onmyōji]] practitioners such as {{ill|Abe no Seimei|en|安倍晴明|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Abe no Seimei|qq=}}. Originating from constellations centered around the {{ill|Polaris|en|北極星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Polaris|qq=}}, each corresponds to principles of {{ill|Yin-Yang and the Five Elements|en|陰陽五行思想|1=Yin-Yang and Wuxing Theory|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yin-Yang and the Five Elements|qq=}}. Although frequently called [[:en:Twelve Heavenly Generals|Jūni Shinshō]], Jūni Tenshō differs significantly from the Buddhist [[:en:Twelve Devas|Twelve Devas]] and {{ill|Twelve Heavenly Generals|en|十二神将|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Twelve Heavenly Generals|qq=}}. In traditional texts like "Rokujin Yaku," the term "Kami" (神) refers specifically to the twelve Earthly Branches (十二支) placed on the heavenly board (天盤), and "Shō" (将) denotes the Twelve Heavenly Generals themselves. Therefore, "Kami-Shō" (神将) refers simultaneously to both the Twelve Branches and their corresponding Twelve Generals, and strictly speaking, labeling Jūni Tenshō as Jūni Shinshō is incorrect. ==List== {{ill|Abe no Seimei|en|安倍晴明|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Abe no Seimei|qq=}}, a renowned [[:en:Onmyōji|Onmyōji]], in Chapter 4 of his work "Senji Ryakuketsu" (占事略决), explains the characteristics associated with each of the Twelve Generals as follows: {{Quotation| '''Former Deities (前):''' * '''First:''' The Soaring Snake, Fire Deity resides in *Si (巳)* – governs fear, terror, and ominous generals (凶将). * '''Second:''' The Vermilion Bird, Fire Deity resides in *Wu (午)* – governs disputes, arguments, and official entanglements (凶将). * '''Third:''' The Six Harmonies, Wood Deity resides in *Mao (卯)* – governs secrecy and harmony, auspicious generals (吉将). * '''Fourth:''' The Hooked Chen, Earth Deity resides in *Chen (辰)* – governs battles, lawsuits, and strife (凶将). * '''Fifth:''' The Azure Dragon, Wood Deity resides in *Yin (寅)* – governs wealth, fortune, and celebration (吉将). * '''Heavenly Nobleman:''' Supreme Deity resides in *Chou (丑)* – governs blessings and virtue, deity of good fortune (吉将), but ends with "Great Nothingness Achieved" (大无成 – possibly an idiom or esoteric phrase meaning culmination or void success). --- '''Later Deities (後):''' * '''First:''' The Queen of Heaven, Water Deity resides in *Hai (亥)* – governs the inner palace and women, auspicious general (吉将). * '''Second:''' The Great Yin, Metal Deity resides in *You (酉)* – governs secrets, concealment, and hidden matters (吉将). * '''Third:''' The Black Tortoise, Water Deity resides in *Zi (子)* – governs loss, theft, and banditry (凶将). * '''Fourth:''' The Great Skirt, Earth Deity resides in *Wei (未)* – governs clothing, robes, and ceremonial dress (吉将). * '''Fifth:''' The White Tiger, Metal Deity resides in *Shen (申)* – governs illness and death (凶将). * '''Sixth:''' The Sky Void, Earth Deity resides in *Xu (戌)* – governs deception, danger, and mistrust (凶将). }} ("Names Reference: Nihon Onmyōdōshi Sōsetsu") The above information is organized below, with aliases included: # [[ja:十二天将]][[zh:十二天將]] {{Infobox deity}}{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[Category:Has wikidata]][[d:Q10904413]] Wikidata name: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 10:11, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{afc comment|1=Apparently different from {{ill|Twelve Heavenly Generals|en|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Twelve Heavenly Generals|qq=}} Here's your translation with proper use of the "{{ill|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/qq=|qq=}}" template: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 18:09, 3 March 2025 (UTC)|qq=}} {{Unreferenced|date=August 2018|qq=}} '''Jūni Tenshō''' (十二天将, lit. Twelve Heavenly Generals) refers to a symbolic system used within the [[:en:Daliuren|Rokujin Shinka]] divination method, which was essential for [[:en:Onmyōji|Onmyōji]] practitioners such as {{ill|Abe no Seimei|en|安倍晴明|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Abe no Seimei|qq=}}. Originating from constellations centered around the {{ill|Polaris|en|北極星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Polaris|qq=}}, each corresponds to principles of {{ill|Yin-Yang and the Five Elements|en|陰陽五行思想|1=Yin-Yang and Wuxing Theory|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yin-Yang and the Five Elements|qq=}}. Although frequently called [[:en:Twelve Heavenly Generals|Jūni Shinshō]], Jūni Tenshō differs significantly from the Buddhist [[:en:Twelve Devas|Twelve Devas]] and {{ill|Twelve Heavenly Generals|en|十二神将|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Twelve Heavenly Generals|qq=}}. In traditional texts like "Rokujin Yaku," the term "Kami" (神) refers specifically to the twelve Earthly Branches (十二支) placed on the heavenly board (天盤), and "Shō" (将) denotes the Twelve Heavenly Generals themselves. Therefore, "Kami-Shō" (神将) refers simultaneously to both the Twelve Branches and their corresponding Twelve Generals, and strictly speaking, labeling Jūni Tenshō as Jūni Shinshō is incorrect. ==List== {{ill|Abe no Seimei|en|安倍晴明|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Abe no Seimei|qq=}}, a renowned [[:en:Onmyōji|Onmyōji]], in Chapter 4 of his work "Senji Ryakuketsu" (占事略决), explains the characteristics associated with each of the Twelve Generals as follows: {{Quotation| '''Former Deities (前):''' * '''First:''' The Soaring Snake, Fire Deity resides in *Si (巳)* – governs fear, terror, and ominous generals (凶将). * '''Second:''' The Vermilion Bird, Fire Deity resides in *Wu (午)* – governs disputes, arguments, and official entanglements (凶将). * '''Third:''' The Six Harmonies, Wood Deity resides in *Mao (卯)* – governs secrecy and harmony, auspicious generals (吉将). * '''Fourth:''' The Hooked Chen, Earth Deity resides in *Chen (辰)* – governs battles, lawsuits, and strife (凶将). * '''Fifth:''' The Azure Dragon, Wood Deity resides in *Yin (寅)* – governs wealth, fortune, and celebration (吉将). * '''Heavenly Nobleman:''' Supreme Deity resides in *Chou (丑)* – governs blessings and virtue, deity of good fortune (吉将), but ends with "Great Nothingness Achieved" (大无成 – possibly an idiom or esoteric phrase meaning culmination or void success). --- '''Later Deities (後):''' * '''First:''' The Queen of Heaven, Water Deity resides in *Hai (亥)* – governs the inner palace and women, auspicious general (吉将). * '''Second:''' The Great Yin, Metal Deity resides in *You (酉)* – governs secrets, concealment, and hidden matters (吉将). * '''Third:''' The Black Tortoise, Water Deity resides in *Zi (子)* – governs loss, theft, and banditry (凶将). * '''Fourth:''' The Great Skirt, Earth Deity resides in *Wei (未)* – governs clothing, robes, and ceremonial dress (吉将). * '''Fifth:''' The White Tiger, Metal Deity resides in *Shen (申)* – governs illness and death (凶将). * '''Sixth:''' The Sky Void, Earth Deity resides in *Xu (戌)* – governs deception, danger, and mistrust (凶将). }} ("Names Reference: Nihon Onmyōdōshi Sōsetsu") The above information is organized below, with aliases included: # [[ja:十二天将]][[zh:十二天將]] {{Infobox deity}}{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[Category:Has wikidata]][[d:Q10904413]] Wikidata name: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 10:11, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{afc comment|1=Apparently different from {{ill|Twelve Heavenly Generals|en|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Twelve Heavenly Generals|qq=}} Here's your translation with proper use of the "{{ill|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/qq=|qq=}}" template: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 18:09, 3 March 2025 (UTC)|qq=}} {{Unreferenced|date=August 2018|qq=}} '''Jūni Tenshō''' (十二天将, lit. Twelve Heavenly Generals) refers to a symbolic system used within the [[:en:Daliuren|Rokujin Shinka]] divination method, which was essential for [[:en:Onmyōji|Onmyōji]] practitioners such as {{ill|Abe no Seimei|en|安倍晴明|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Abe no Seimei|qq=}}. Originating from constellations centered around the {{ill|Polaris|en|北極星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Polaris|qq=}}, each corresponds to principles of {{ill|Yin-Yang and the Five Elements|en|陰陽五行思想|1=Yin-Yang and Wuxing Theory|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yin-Yang and the Five Elements|qq=}}. Although frequently called [[:en:Twelve Heavenly Generals|Jūni Shinshō]], Jūni Tenshō differs significantly from the Buddhist [[:en:Twelve Devas|Twelve Devas]] and {{ill|Twelve Heavenly Generals|en|十二神将|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Twelve Heavenly Generals|qq=}}. In traditional texts like "Rokujin Yaku," the term "Kami" (神) refers specifically to the twelve Earthly Branches (十二支) placed on the heavenly board (天盤), and "Shō" (将) denotes the Twelve Heavenly Generals themselves. Therefore, "Kami-Shō" (神将) refers simultaneously to both the Twelve Branches and their corresponding Twelve Generals, and strictly speaking, labeling Jūni Tenshō as Jūni Shinshō is incorrect. ==List== {{ill|Abe no Seimei|en|安倍晴明|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Abe no Seimei|qq=}}, a renowned [[:en:Onmyōji|Onmyōji]], in Chapter 4 of his work "Senji Ryakuketsu" (占事略决), explains the characteristics associated with each of the Twelve Generals as follows: {{Quotation| '''Former Deities (前):''' * '''First:''' The Soaring Snake, Fire Deity resides in *Si (巳)* – governs fear, terror, and ominous generals (凶将). * '''Second:''' The Vermilion Bird, Fire Deity resides in *Wu (午)* – governs disputes, arguments, and official entanglements (凶将). * '''Third:''' The Six Harmonies, Wood Deity resides in *Mao (卯)* – governs secrecy and harmony, auspicious generals (吉将). * '''Fourth:''' The Hooked Chen, Earth Deity resides in *Chen (辰)* – governs battles, lawsuits, and strife (凶将). * '''Fifth:''' The Azure Dragon, Wood Deity resides in *Yin (寅)* – governs wealth, fortune, and celebration (吉将). * '''Heavenly Nobleman:''' Supreme Deity resides in *Chou (丑)* – governs blessings and virtue, deity of good fortune (吉将), but ends with "Great Nothingness Achieved" (大无成 – possibly an idiom or esoteric phrase meaning culmination or void success). --- '''Later Deities (後):''' * '''First:''' The Queen of Heaven, Water Deity resides in *Hai (亥)* – governs the inner palace and women, auspicious general (吉将). * '''Second:''' The Great Yin, Metal Deity resides in *You (酉)* – governs secrets, concealment, and hidden matters (吉将). * '''Third:''' The Black Tortoise, Water Deity resides in *Zi (子)* – governs loss, theft, and banditry (凶将). * '''Fourth:''' The Great Skirt, Earth Deity resides in *Wei (未)* – governs clothing, robes, and ceremonial dress (吉将). * '''Fifth:''' The White Tiger, Metal Deity resides in *Shen (申)* – governs illness and death (凶将). * '''Sixth:''' The Sky Void, Earth Deity resides in *Xu (戌)* – governs deception, danger, and mistrust (凶将). }} ("Names Reference: Nihon Onmyōdōshi Sōsetsu") The above information is organized below, with aliases included: # [[ja:十二天将]][[zh:十二天將]] {{Infobox deity}}{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[Category:Has wikidata]][[d:Q10904413]] Wikidata name: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 10:11, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{afc comment|1=Apparently different from {{ill|Twelve Heavenly Generals|en|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Twelve Heavenly Generals|qq=}} Here's your translation with proper use of the "{{ill|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/qq=|qq=}}" template: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 18:09, 3 March 2025 (UTC)|qq=}} {{Unreferenced|date=August 2018|qq=}} '''Jūni Tenshō''' (十二天将, lit. Twelve Heavenly Generals) refers to a symbolic system used within the [[:en:Daliuren|Rokujin Shinka]] divination method, which was essential for [[:en:Onmyōji|Onmyōji]] practitioners such as {{ill|Abe no Seimei|en|安倍晴明|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Abe no Seimei|qq=}}. Originating from constellations centered around the {{ill|Polaris|en|北極星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Polaris|qq=}}, each corresponds to principles of {{ill|Yin-Yang and the Five Elements|en|陰陽五行思想|1=Yin-Yang and Wuxing Theory|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yin-Yang and the Five Elements|qq=}}. Although frequently called [[:en:Twelve Heavenly Generals|Jūni Shinshō]], Jūni Tenshō differs significantly from the Buddhist [[:en:Twelve Devas|Twelve Devas]] and {{ill|Twelve Heavenly Generals|en|十二神将|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Twelve Heavenly Generals|qq=}}. In traditional texts like "Rokujin Yaku," the term "Kami" (神) refers specifically to the twelve Earthly Branches (十二支) placed on the heavenly board (天盤), and "Shō" (将) denotes the Twelve Heavenly Generals themselves. Therefore, "Kami-Shō" (神将) refers simultaneously to both the Twelve Branches and their corresponding Twelve Generals, and strictly speaking, labeling Jūni Tenshō as Jūni Shinshō is incorrect. ==List== {{ill|Abe no Seimei|en|安倍晴明|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Abe no Seimei|qq=}}, a renowned [[:en:Onmyōji|Onmyōji]], in Chapter 4 of his work "Senji Ryakuketsu" (占事略决), explains the characteristics associated with each of the Twelve Generals as follows: {{Quotation| '''Former Deities (前):''' * '''First:''' The Soaring Snake, Fire Deity resides in *Si (巳)* – governs fear, terror, and ominous generals (凶将). * '''Second:''' The Vermilion Bird, Fire Deity resides in *Wu (午)* – governs disputes, arguments, and official entanglements (凶将). * '''Third:''' The Six Harmonies, Wood Deity resides in *Mao (卯)* – governs secrecy and harmony, auspicious generals (吉将). * '''Fourth:''' The Hooked Chen, Earth Deity resides in *Chen (辰)* – governs battles, lawsuits, and strife (凶将). * '''Fifth:''' The Azure Dragon, Wood Deity resides in *Yin (寅)* – governs wealth, fortune, and celebration (吉将). * '''Heavenly Nobleman:''' Supreme Deity resides in *Chou (丑)* – governs blessings and virtue, deity of good fortune (吉将), but ends with "Great Nothingness Achieved" (大无成 – possibly an idiom or esoteric phrase meaning culmination or void success). --- '''Later Deities (後):''' * '''First:''' The Queen of Heaven, Water Deity resides in *Hai (亥)* – governs the inner palace and women, auspicious general (吉将). * '''Second:''' The Great Yin, Metal Deity resides in *You (酉)* – governs secrets, concealment, and hidden matters (吉将). * '''Third:''' The Black Tortoise, Water Deity resides in *Zi (子)* – governs loss, theft, and banditry (凶将). * '''Fourth:''' The Great Skirt, Earth Deity resides in *Wei (未)* – governs clothing, robes, and ceremonial dress (吉将). * '''Fifth:''' The White Tiger, Metal Deity resides in *Shen (申)* – governs illness and death (凶将). * '''Sixth:''' The Sky Void, Earth Deity resides in *Xu (戌)* – governs deception, danger, and mistrust (凶将). }} ("Names Reference: Nihon Onmyōdōshi Sōsetsu") The above information is organized below, with aliases included: # [[ja:十二天将]][[zh:十二天將]] {{Infobox deity}}{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[Category:Has wikidata]][[d:Q10904413]] Wikidata name: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 10:11, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{afc comment|1=Apparently different from {{ill|Twelve Heavenly Generals|en|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Twelve Heavenly Generals|qq=}} Here's your translation with proper use of the "{{ill|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/qq=|qq=}}" template: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 18:09, 3 March 2025 (UTC)|qq=}} {{Unreferenced|date=August 2018|qq=}} '''Jūni Tenshō''' (十二天将, lit. Twelve Heavenly Generals) refers to a symbolic system used within the [[:en:Daliuren|Rokujin Shinka]] divination method, which was essential for [[:en:Onmyōji|Onmyōji]] practitioners such as {{ill|Abe no Seimei|en|安倍晴明|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Abe no Seimei|qq=}}. Originating from constellations centered around the {{ill|Polaris|en|北極星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Polaris|qq=}}, each corresponds to principles of {{ill|Yin-Yang and the Five Elements|en|陰陽五行思想|1=Yin-Yang and Wuxing Theory|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yin-Yang and the Five Elements|qq=}}. Although frequently called [[:en:Twelve Heavenly Generals|Jūni Shinshō]], Jūni Tenshō differs significantly from the Buddhist [[:en:Twelve Devas|Twelve Devas]] and {{ill|Twelve Heavenly Generals|en|十二神将|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Twelve Heavenly Generals|qq=}}. In traditional texts like "Rokujin Yaku," the term "Kami" (神) refers specifically to the twelve Earthly Branches (十二支) placed on the heavenly board (天盤), and "Shō" (将) denotes the Twelve Heavenly Generals themselves. Therefore, "Kami-Shō" (神将) refers simultaneously to both the Twelve Branches and their corresponding Twelve Generals, and strictly speaking, labeling Jūni Tenshō as Jūni Shinshō is incorrect. ==List== {{ill|Abe no Seimei|en|安倍晴明|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Abe no Seimei|qq=}}, a renowned [[:en:Onmyōji|Onmyōji]], in Chapter 4 of his work "Senji Ryakuketsu" (占事略决), explains the characteristics associated with each of the Twelve Generals as follows: {{Quotation| '''Former Deities (前):''' * '''First:''' The Soaring Snake, Fire Deity resides in *Si (巳)* – governs fear, terror, and ominous generals (凶将). * '''Second:''' The Vermilion Bird, Fire Deity resides in *Wu (午)* – governs disputes, arguments, and official entanglements (凶将). * '''Third:''' The Six Harmonies, Wood Deity resides in *Mao (卯)* – governs secrecy and harmony, auspicious generals (吉将). * '''Fourth:''' The Hooked Chen, Earth Deity resides in *Chen (辰)* – governs battles, lawsuits, and strife (凶将). * '''Fifth:''' The Azure Dragon, Wood Deity resides in *Yin (寅)* – governs wealth, fortune, and celebration (吉将). * '''Heavenly Nobleman:''' Supreme Deity resides in *Chou (丑)* – governs blessings and virtue, deity of good fortune (吉将), but ends with "Great Nothingness Achieved" (大无成 – possibly an idiom or esoteric phrase meaning culmination or void success). --- '''Later Deities (後):''' * '''First:''' The Queen of Heaven, Water Deity resides in *Hai (亥)* – governs the inner palace and women, auspicious general (吉将). * '''Second:''' The Great Yin, Metal Deity resides in *You (酉)* – governs secrets, concealment, and hidden matters (吉将). * '''Third:''' The Black Tortoise, Water Deity resides in *Zi (子)* – governs loss, theft, and banditry (凶将). * '''Fourth:''' The Great Skirt, Earth Deity resides in *Wei (未)* – governs clothing, robes, and ceremonial dress (吉将). * '''Fifth:''' The White Tiger, Metal Deity resides in *Shen (申)* – governs illness and death (凶将). * '''Sixth:''' The Sky Void, Earth Deity resides in *Xu (戌)* – governs deception, danger, and mistrust (凶将). }} ("Names Reference: Nihon Onmyōdōshi Sōsetsu") The above information is organized below, with aliases included: # [[ja:十二天将]][[zh:十二天將]] {{Infobox deity}}{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[Category:Has wikidata]][[d:Q10904413]] Wikidata name: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 10:11, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{afc comment|1=Apparently different from {{ill|Twelve Heavenly Generals|en|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Twelve Heavenly Generals|qq=}} Here's your translation with proper use of the "{{ill|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/qq=|qq=}}" template: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 18:09, 3 March 2025 (UTC)|qq=}} {{Unreferenced|date=August 2018|qq=}} '''Jūni Tenshō''' (十二天将, lit. Twelve Heavenly Generals) refers to a symbolic system used within the [[:en:Daliuren|Rokujin Shinka]] divination method, which was essential for [[:en:Onmyōji|Onmyōji]] practitioners such as {{ill|Abe no Seimei|en|安倍晴明|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Abe no Seimei|qq=}}. Originating from constellations centered around the {{ill|Polaris|en|北極星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Polaris|qq=}}, each corresponds to principles of {{ill|Yin-Yang and the Five Elements|en|陰陽五行思想|1=Yin-Yang and Wuxing Theory|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yin-Yang and the Five Elements|qq=}}. Although frequently called [[:en:Twelve Heavenly Generals|Jūni Shinshō]], Jūni Tenshō differs significantly from the Buddhist [[:en:Twelve Devas|Twelve Devas]] and {{ill|Twelve Heavenly Generals|en|十二神将|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Twelve Heavenly Generals|qq=}}. In traditional texts like "Rokujin Yaku," the term "Kami" (神) refers specifically to the twelve Earthly Branches (十二支) placed on the heavenly board (天盤), and "Shō" (将) denotes the Twelve Heavenly Generals themselves. Therefore, "Kami-Shō" (神将) refers simultaneously to both the Twelve Branches and their corresponding Twelve Generals, and strictly speaking, labeling Jūni Tenshō as Jūni Shinshō is incorrect. ==List== {{ill|Abe no Seimei|en|安倍晴明|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Abe no Seimei|qq=}}, a renowned [[:en:Onmyōji|Onmyōji]], in Chapter 4 of his work "Senji Ryakuketsu" (占事略决), explains the characteristics associated with each of the Twelve Generals as follows: {{Quotation| '''Former Deities (前):''' * '''First:''' The Soaring Snake, Fire Deity resides in *Si (巳)* – governs fear, terror, and ominous generals (凶将). * '''Second:''' The Vermilion Bird, Fire Deity resides in *Wu (午)* – governs disputes, arguments, and official entanglements (凶将). * '''Third:''' The Six Harmonies, Wood Deity resides in *Mao (卯)* – governs secrecy and harmony, auspicious generals (吉将). * '''Fourth:''' The Hooked Chen, Earth Deity resides in *Chen (辰)* – governs battles, lawsuits, and strife (凶将). * '''Fifth:''' The Azure Dragon, Wood Deity resides in *Yin (寅)* – governs wealth, fortune, and celebration (吉将). * '''Heavenly Nobleman:''' Supreme Deity resides in *Chou (丑)* – governs blessings and virtue, deity of good fortune (吉将), but ends with "Great Nothingness Achieved" (大无成 – possibly an idiom or esoteric phrase meaning culmination or void success). --- '''Later Deities (後):''' * '''First:''' The Queen of Heaven, Water Deity resides in *Hai (亥)* – governs the inner palace and women, auspicious general (吉将). * '''Second:''' The Great Yin, Metal Deity resides in *You (酉)* – governs secrets, concealment, and hidden matters (吉将). * '''Third:''' The Black Tortoise, Water Deity resides in *Zi (子)* – governs loss, theft, and banditry (凶将). * '''Fourth:''' The Great Skirt, Earth Deity resides in *Wei (未)* – governs clothing, robes, and ceremonial dress (吉将). * '''Fifth:''' The White Tiger, Metal Deity resides in *Shen (申)* – governs illness and death (凶将). * '''Sixth:''' The Sky Void, Earth Deity resides in *Xu (戌)* – governs deception, danger, and mistrust (凶将). }} ("Names Reference: Nihon Onmyōdōshi Sōsetsu") The above information is organized below, with aliases included: # [[ja:十二天将]][[zh:十二天將]] {{Infobox deity}}{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[Category:Has wikidata]][[d:Q10904413]] Wikidata name: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 10:11, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{afc comment|1=Apparently different from {{ill|Twelve Heavenly Generals|en|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Twelve Heavenly Generals|qq=}} Here's your translation with proper use of the "{{ill|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/qq=|qq=}}" template: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 18:09, 3 March 2025 (UTC)|qq=}} {{Unreferenced|date=August 2018|qq=}} '''Jūni Tenshō''' (十二天将, lit. Twelve Heavenly Generals) refers to a symbolic system used within the [[:en:Daliuren|Rokujin Shinka]] divination method, which was essential for [[:en:Onmyōji|Onmyōji]] practitioners such as {{ill|Abe no Seimei|en|安倍晴明|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Abe no Seimei|qq=}}. Originating from constellations centered around the {{ill|Polaris|en|北極星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Polaris|qq=}}, each corresponds to principles of {{ill|Yin-Yang and the Five Elements|en|陰陽五行思想|1=Yin-Yang and Wuxing Theory|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yin-Yang and the Five Elements|qq=}}. Although frequently called [[:en:Twelve Heavenly Generals|Jūni Shinshō]], Jūni Tenshō differs significantly from the Buddhist [[:en:Twelve Devas|Twelve Devas]] and {{ill|Twelve Heavenly Generals|en|十二神将|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Twelve Heavenly Generals|qq=}}. In traditional texts like "Rokujin Yaku," the term "Kami" (神) refers specifically to the twelve Earthly Branches (十二支) placed on the heavenly board (天盤), and "Shō" (将) denotes the Twelve Heavenly Generals themselves. Therefore, "Kami-Shō" (神将) refers simultaneously to both the Twelve Branches and their corresponding Twelve Generals, and strictly speaking, labeling Jūni Tenshō as Jūni Shinshō is incorrect. ==List== {{ill|Abe no Seimei|en|安倍晴明|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Abe no Seimei|qq=}}, a renowned [[:en:Onmyōji|Onmyōji]], in Chapter 4 of his work "Senji Ryakuketsu" (占事略决), explains the characteristics associated with each of the Twelve Generals as follows: {{Quotation| '''Former Deities (前):''' * '''First:''' The Soaring Snake, Fire Deity resides in *Si (巳)* – governs fear, terror, and ominous generals (凶将). * '''Second:''' The Vermilion Bird, Fire Deity resides in *Wu (午)* – governs disputes, arguments, and official entanglements (凶将). * '''Third:''' The Six Harmonies, Wood Deity resides in *Mao (卯)* – governs secrecy and harmony, auspicious generals (吉将). * '''Fourth:''' The Hooked Chen, Earth Deity resides in *Chen (辰)* – governs battles, lawsuits, and strife (凶将). * '''Fifth:''' The Azure Dragon, Wood Deity resides in *Yin (寅)* – governs wealth, fortune, and celebration (吉将). * '''Heavenly Nobleman:''' Supreme Deity resides in *Chou (丑)* – governs blessings and virtue, deity of good fortune (吉将), but ends with "Great Nothingness Achieved" (大无成 – possibly an idiom or esoteric phrase meaning culmination or void success). --- '''Later Deities (後):''' * '''First:''' The Queen of Heaven, Water Deity resides in *Hai (亥)* – governs the inner palace and women, auspicious general (吉将). * '''Second:''' The Great Yin, Metal Deity resides in *You (酉)* – governs secrets, concealment, and hidden matters (吉将). * '''Third:''' The Black Tortoise, Water Deity resides in *Zi (子)* – governs loss, theft, and banditry (凶将). * '''Fourth:''' The Great Skirt, Earth Deity resides in *Wei (未)* – governs clothing, robes, and ceremonial dress (吉将). * '''Fifth:''' The White Tiger, Metal Deity resides in *Shen (申)* – governs illness and death (凶将). * '''Sixth:''' The Sky Void, Earth Deity resides in *Xu (戌)* – governs deception, danger, and mistrust (凶将). }} ("Names Reference: Nihon Onmyōdōshi Sōsetsu") The above information is organized below, with aliases included: # [[ja:十二天将]][[zh:十二天將]] {{Infobox deity}}{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[Category:Has wikidata]][[d:Q10904413]] Wikidata name: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 10:11, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{afc comment|1=Apparently different from {{ill|Twelve Heavenly Generals|en|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Twelve Heavenly Generals|qq=}} Here's your translation with proper use of the "{{ill|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/qq=|qq=}}" template: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 18:09, 3 March 2025 (UTC)|qq=}} {{Unreferenced|date=August 2018|qq=}} '''Jūni Tenshō''' (十二天将, lit. Twelve Heavenly Generals) refers to a symbolic system used within the [[:en:Daliuren|Rokujin Shinka]] divination method, which was essential for [[:en:Onmyōji|Onmyōji]] practitioners such as {{ill|Abe no Seimei|en|安倍晴明|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Abe no Seimei|qq=}}. Originating from constellations centered around the {{ill|Polaris|en|北極星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Polaris|qq=}}, each corresponds to principles of {{ill|Yin-Yang and the Five Elements|en|陰陽五行思想|1=Yin-Yang and Wuxing Theory|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yin-Yang and the Five Elements|qq=}}. Although frequently called [[:en:Twelve Heavenly Generals|Jūni Shinshō]], Jūni Tenshō differs significantly from the Buddhist [[:en:Twelve Devas|Twelve Devas]] and {{ill|Twelve Heavenly Generals|en|十二神将|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Twelve Heavenly Generals|qq=}}. In traditional texts like "Rokujin Yaku," the term "Kami" (神) refers specifically to the twelve Earthly Branches (十二支) placed on the heavenly board (天盤), and "Shō" (将) denotes the Twelve Heavenly Generals themselves. Therefore, "Kami-Shō" (神将) refers simultaneously to both the Twelve Branches and their corresponding Twelve Generals, and strictly speaking, labeling Jūni Tenshō as Jūni Shinshō is incorrect. ==List== {{ill|Abe no Seimei|en|安倍晴明|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Abe no Seimei|qq=}}, a renowned [[:en:Onmyōji|Onmyōji]], in Chapter 4 of his work "Senji Ryakuketsu" (占事略决), explains the characteristics associated with each of the Twelve Generals as follows: {{Quotation| '''Former Deities (前):''' * '''First:''' The Soaring Snake, Fire Deity resides in *Si (巳)* – governs fear, terror, and ominous generals (凶将). * '''Second:''' The Vermilion Bird, Fire Deity resides in *Wu (午)* – governs disputes, arguments, and official entanglements (凶将). * '''Third:''' The Six Harmonies, Wood Deity resides in *Mao (卯)* – governs secrecy and harmony, auspicious generals (吉将). * '''Fourth:''' The Hooked Chen, Earth Deity resides in *Chen (辰)* – governs battles, lawsuits, and strife (凶将). * '''Fifth:''' The Azure Dragon, Wood Deity resides in *Yin (寅)* – governs wealth, fortune, and celebration (吉将). * '''Heavenly Nobleman:''' Supreme Deity resides in *Chou (丑)* – governs blessings and virtue, deity of good fortune (吉将), but ends with "Great Nothingness Achieved" (大无成 – possibly an idiom or esoteric phrase meaning culmination or void success). --- '''Later Deities (後):''' * '''First:''' The Queen of Heaven, Water Deity resides in *Hai (亥)* – governs the inner palace and women, auspicious general (吉将). * '''Second:''' The Great Yin, Metal Deity resides in *You (酉)* – governs secrets, concealment, and hidden matters (吉将). * '''Third:''' The Black Tortoise, Water Deity resides in *Zi (子)* – governs loss, theft, and banditry (凶将). * '''Fourth:''' The Great Skirt, Earth Deity resides in *Wei (未)* – governs clothing, robes, and ceremonial dress (吉将). * '''Fifth:''' The White Tiger, Metal Deity resides in *Shen (申)* – governs illness and death (凶将). * '''Sixth:''' The Sky Void, Earth Deity resides in *Xu (戌)* – governs deception, danger, and mistrust (凶将). }} ("Names Reference: Nihon Onmyōdōshi Sōsetsu") The above information is organized below, with aliases included: # [[ja:十二天将]][[zh:十二天將]] {{Infobox deity}}{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[Category:Has wikidata]][[d:Q10904413]] Wikidata name: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 10:11, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{afc comment|1=Apparently different from {{ill|Twelve Heavenly Generals|en|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Twelve Heavenly Generals|qq=}} Here's your translation with proper use of the "{{ill|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/qq=|qq=}}" template: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 18:09, 3 March 2025 (UTC)|qq=}} {{Unreferenced|date=August 2018|qq=}} '''Jūni Tenshō''' (十二天将, lit. Twelve Heavenly Generals) refers to a symbolic system used within the [[:en:Daliuren|Rokujin Shinka]] divination method, which was essential for [[:en:Onmyōji|Onmyōji]] practitioners such as {{ill|Abe no Seimei|en|安倍晴明|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Abe no Seimei|qq=}}. Originating from constellations centered around the {{ill|Polaris|en|北極星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Polaris|qq=}}, each corresponds to principles of {{ill|Yin-Yang and the Five Elements|en|陰陽五行思想|1=Yin-Yang and Wuxing Theory|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yin-Yang and the Five Elements|qq=}}. Although frequently called [[:en:Twelve Heavenly Generals|Jūni Shinshō]], Jūni Tenshō differs significantly from the Buddhist [[:en:Twelve Devas|Twelve Devas]] and {{ill|Twelve Heavenly Generals|en|十二神将|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Twelve Heavenly Generals|qq=}}. In traditional texts like "Rokujin Yaku," the term "Kami" (神) refers specifically to the twelve Earthly Branches (十二支) placed on the heavenly board (天盤), and "Shō" (将) denotes the Twelve Heavenly Generals themselves. Therefore, "Kami-Shō" (神将) refers simultaneously to both the Twelve Branches and their corresponding Twelve Generals, and strictly speaking, labeling Jūni Tenshō as Jūni Shinshō is incorrect. ==List== {{ill|Abe no Seimei|en|安倍晴明|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Abe no Seimei|qq=}}, a renowned [[:en:Onmyōji|Onmyōji]], in Chapter 4 of his work "Senji Ryakuketsu" (占事略决), explains the characteristics associated with each of the Twelve Generals as follows: {{Quotation| '''Former Deities (前):''' * '''First:''' The Soaring Snake, Fire Deity resides in *Si (巳)* – governs fear, terror, and ominous generals (凶将). * '''Second:''' The Vermilion Bird, Fire Deity resides in *Wu (午)* – governs disputes, arguments, and official entanglements (凶将). * '''Third:''' The Six Harmonies, Wood Deity resides in *Mao (卯)* – governs secrecy and harmony, auspicious generals (吉将). * '''Fourth:''' The Hooked Chen, Earth Deity resides in *Chen (辰)* – governs battles, lawsuits, and strife (凶将). * '''Fifth:''' The Azure Dragon, Wood Deity resides in *Yin (寅)* – governs wealth, fortune, and celebration (吉将). * '''Heavenly Nobleman:''' Supreme Deity resides in *Chou (丑)* – governs blessings and virtue, deity of good fortune (吉将), but ends with "Great Nothingness Achieved" (大无成 – possibly an idiom or esoteric phrase meaning culmination or void success). --- '''Later Deities (後):''' * '''First:''' The Queen of Heaven, Water Deity resides in *Hai (亥)* – governs the inner palace and women, auspicious general (吉将). * '''Second:''' The Great Yin, Metal Deity resides in *You (酉)* – governs secrets, concealment, and hidden matters (吉将). * '''Third:''' The Black Tortoise, Water Deity resides in *Zi (子)* – governs loss, theft, and banditry (凶将). * '''Fourth:''' The Great Skirt, Earth Deity resides in *Wei (未)* – governs clothing, robes, and ceremonial dress (吉将). * '''Fifth:''' The White Tiger, Metal Deity resides in *Shen (申)* – governs illness and death (凶将). * '''Sixth:''' The Sky Void, Earth Deity resides in *Xu (戌)* – governs deception, danger, and mistrust (凶将). }} ("Names Reference: Nihon Onmyōdōshi Sōsetsu") The above information is organized below, with aliases included: # [[ja:十二天将]][[zh:十二天將]] {{Infobox deity}}{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[Category:Has wikidata]][[d:Q10904413]] Wikidata name: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 10:11, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{afc comment|1=Apparently different from {{ill|Twelve Heavenly Generals|en|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Twelve Heavenly Generals|qq=}} Here's your translation with proper use of the "{{ill|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/qq=|qq=}}" template: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 18:09, 3 March 2025 (UTC)|qq=}} {{Unreferenced|date=August 2018|qq=}} '''Jūni Tenshō''' (十二天将, lit. Twelve Heavenly Generals) refers to a symbolic system used within the [[:en:Daliuren|Rokujin Shinka]] divination method, which was essential for [[:en:Onmyōji|Onmyōji]] practitioners such as {{ill|Abe no Seimei|en|安倍晴明|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Abe no Seimei|qq=}}. Originating from constellations centered around the {{ill|Polaris|en|北極星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Polaris|qq=}}, each corresponds to principles of {{ill|Yin-Yang and the Five Elements|en|陰陽五行思想|1=Yin-Yang and Wuxing Theory|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yin-Yang and the Five Elements|qq=}}. Although frequently called [[:en:Twelve Heavenly Generals|Jūni Shinshō]], Jūni Tenshō differs significantly from the Buddhist [[:en:Twelve Devas|Twelve Devas]] and {{ill|Twelve Heavenly Generals|en|十二神将|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Twelve Heavenly Generals|qq=}}. In traditional texts like "Rokujin Yaku," the term "Kami" (神) refers specifically to the twelve Earthly Branches (十二支) placed on the heavenly board (天盤), and "Shō" (将) denotes the Twelve Heavenly Generals themselves. Therefore, "Kami-Shō" (神将) refers simultaneously to both the Twelve Branches and their corresponding Twelve Generals, and strictly speaking, labeling Jūni Tenshō as Jūni Shinshō is incorrect. ==List== {{ill|Abe no Seimei|en|安倍晴明|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Abe no Seimei|qq=}}, a renowned [[:en:Onmyōji|Onmyōji]], in Chapter 4 of his work "Senji Ryakuketsu" (占事略决), explains the characteristics associated with each of the Twelve Generals as follows: {{Quotation| '''Former Deities (前):''' * '''First:''' The Soaring Snake, Fire Deity resides in *Si (巳)* – governs fear, terror, and ominous generals (凶将). * '''Second:''' The Vermilion Bird, Fire Deity resides in *Wu (午)* – governs disputes, arguments, and official entanglements (凶将). * '''Third:''' The Six Harmonies, Wood Deity resides in *Mao (卯)* – governs secrecy and harmony, auspicious generals (吉将). * '''Fourth:''' The Hooked Chen, Earth Deity resides in *Chen (辰)* – governs battles, lawsuits, and strife (凶将). * '''Fifth:''' The Azure Dragon, Wood Deity resides in *Yin (寅)* – governs wealth, fortune, and celebration (吉将). * '''Heavenly Nobleman:''' Supreme Deity resides in *Chou (丑)* – governs blessings and virtue, deity of good fortune (吉将), but ends with "Great Nothingness Achieved" (大无成 – possibly an idiom or esoteric phrase meaning culmination or void success). --- '''Later Deities (後):''' * '''First:''' The Queen of Heaven, Water Deity resides in *Hai (亥)* – governs the inner palace and women, auspicious general (吉将). * '''Second:''' The Great Yin, Metal Deity resides in *You (酉)* – governs secrets, concealment, and hidden matters (吉将). * '''Third:''' The Black Tortoise, Water Deity resides in *Zi (子)* – governs loss, theft, and banditry (凶将). * '''Fourth:''' The Great Skirt, Earth Deity resides in *Wei (未)* – governs clothing, robes, and ceremonial dress (吉将). * '''Fifth:''' The White Tiger, Metal Deity resides in *Shen (申)* – governs illness and death (凶将). * '''Sixth:''' The Sky Void, Earth Deity resides in *Xu (戌)* – governs deception, danger, and mistrust (凶将). }} ("Names Reference: Nihon Onmyōdōshi Sōsetsu") The above information is organized below, with aliases included: # Inauspicious) # {{ill|Rikugō|ja|六合 (十二天将)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Rikugō|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} (Wood, East, Harmony, Auspicious) #
